paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: Paper reports 95% CL upper limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma in the mass range 0.165 ≤ m_a ≤ 2.84 GeV/c². The most stringent constraints are for 0.165 ≤ m_a ≤ 1.468 GeV/c². Data extracted from Fig. 6 (exclusion plot) and text stating 'Our limits exclude the region in the ALP-photon coupling range g_agamma > 3 × 10^-4 GeV^-1 for an ALP mass m_a around 0.25 GeV/c^2'. The coupling values represent approximate boundary points of the excluded region. Detailed numerical limits for all 674 mass hypotheses are implicit in the exclusion curve but not tabulated in the paper. The analysis searches for J/ψ → γa, a → γγ decays using ψ(3686) → π⁺π⁻J/ψ events. No significant signal observed; largest local significance 2.6σ at m_a = 2.208 GeV/c². | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.92, 4))
